summary: Invokes a virtual predicate method through a COM-style pointer-to-pointer handle: dereferences this+0x0 to reach the object, reads the vtable pointer from obj+0x0, fetches the method at vtable offset 0xA0, and calls it with (*this, a2, a3, a4). Returns TRUE when the method returns 0, FALSE otherwise.

operations.description: Dereference the handle: obj = *this, then obj+0x0 holds the vtable pointer, and the target method is at vtable offset 0xA0.

Compare the method result to 0; the comparison result is returned as a BOOL.
